what: A wavetable synthesizer: two oscillators that morph through 130 wavetables, with unison and warps, a ladder filter, a modulation matrix and effects. Its 32-step sequencer can move the wavetable and the filter on every step.
author: BARNIR
sounds: own: wavetables stored as harmonics, made from formulas and from resyntheses of CC0 and CC BY sources credited in TABELLEN.md; no recorded audio
